## What these figures mean

As for vols. 1–3 and 6: see `ocr/03/articles-report.md` for how articles are located, and
`ocr/06/articles-report.md` for `folded`. Every row is `status: "ocr"`. Nothing is proofread.

## Vol. 11 specifics

- Located 93.0% (24.3% by fuzzy match), label + body 86.2%, analysis 75.1%.
- **Against the typed witnesses** (`docs/witness-join.md`, `docs/witness-pndaza.md`): labels agree on 98.5% of 4,882 rows where both have one; analyses are ≥ 0.8 / < 0.4 similar in 86.9% / 0.7%. Pn Daza's page-referenced copy gives a typed text for 399 of the articles the OCR could not place.
- P. 478 (0 of 18): the column text splits the headwords of the နန္ဒနဝန… run (နန္ဒန on a line of its own); the image was not checked. Pp. 250–251 (2 of 23, 3 of 15) print ဓမ္မဿ(သ)ဝန…, the index's two spellings in one head.

## Spot check

One page, p. 444 (a page near the middle of the book with 9–14 headwords): 13 of 13; labels 13, all as the witness.
Checked in the text (each placed row opens on its headword, with its label) and against the typed witness page by page; the image was not opened.
For this batch the spot check is one page per book, not three: vols. 10–19 are checked page by page against the typed witness instead, and the three books without one (14/3, 20, 22) on the image.
